observations: Photo 0 shows a large industrial machine with a control panel, blue and beige cabinet, and vertical hydraulic or press components.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from a slightly different angle, with the control panel, blue cabinet, and vertical components visible.
The machine has a digital display on the control panel, which appears to show '00:00' in photo 1.
The machine is on wheels, suggesting mobility.
There is visible wear and dirt on the machine, especially on the right side in photo 1.
The machine appears to be a press or forming machine, possibly for metal or plastic parts.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine in either photo.
The seller claims it is in 'top working condition' and part of a 'fully automated system'.

risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown mechanical condition

risks.risk: The machine may not be compatible with the buyer's existing setup or may require significant modifications.

Close-up photos of the hydraulic system and electrical connections.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
